text: The Patriots face the Jaguars this Sunday with some personnel complications in their secondary and linebacker corps: Carlton Davis III is set to return, but Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and Quintayvious Hutchins (knee) are ruled out, with Hutchins now placed on injured reserve, while rookie tight end Eli Raridon returns to practice and appears headed toward availability. The offense continues to be a work in progress—the defense carried the team to a dominant 20-3 victory over the Steelers with TreVeyon Henderson scoring on the ground, but the Patriots' offensive inconsistency persists, and they've already drawn self-criticism for questionable clock management decisions late in the second quarter over the past two games, an area coach Bill Belichick's staff is determined to address before Jacksonville comes to town. The Jaguars, meanwhile, are expecting a favorable matchup against a New England team still very much "finding ourselves" according to their own assessment, giving Trevor Lawrence and company hope to bounce back from their worst offensive performance in eleven months.
